column1: REPRODUCTION DOCUMENT — Not an original L&R Mfg. Co. technical publication. Reverse-engineered from direct physical measurement of specimen S/N 13505. Curated by Hobbs R.E. 2026. For restoration reference only.

SCOPE: Power-head parts OUTSIDE the motor — the spindle/drive train (SPN-), the platform/deck + jar seal (PLT-), and the basket family (BSK-). Includes both shaft-driven parts and stationary parts mounted to the motor housing. The motor itself (UH/LH/FLG/SHF/ARM/BRG/STR) is in 'Motor Assembly Parts Dictionary.csv'. Most rows are PROVISIONAL pending bench confirmation + measurement.

column3: Aluminum Shaft / Basket Spindle / Center Column
column4: ONE-PIECE cast aluminum spindle that carries the basket (per user). The armature LOWER journal (SHF-003, Ø0.280") slides INTO the spindle bore and is retained by a set screw (SPN-005). Integral features: impeller/fan vanes + a basket-mount ring/cage at the lower end; the basket mounts onto this. MEASURED 2026-06-15 (Mitutoyo): bore ID 0.2805" (CONFIRMED — slip-fit over SHF-003 Ø0.280"); body OD 0.5065" (CONFIRMED); length impeller-hub-to-shaft-end 3.05" (CONFIRMED, user 2026-06-15 — this is the earlier 3.0505" reading, a LENGTH not the ring OD as first logged); basket-mount ring OD 2.703" (CONFIRMED, re-measured — earlier 3.0505" was a mislabel), ring ID 2.425" (CONFIRMED), ring height 0.277" (CONFIRMED); earlier 2.6960" reading DISCARDED (unclear/misread; hub-to-end stands at 3.05"). Impeller = 3 cast vanes (CONFIRMED); surrounding basket-mount ring carries 3 retention pins/studs ~120 deg apart (CONFIRMED — basket bayonet lugs hook onto these): pin dia 0.125", pin height 0.145", pin-circle dia 2.92" (1.46" radius x 2) (all CONFIRMED); set-screw cross-hole near top of shaft (CONFIRMED — SPN-005 location). Impeller + hub are CAST AS ONE PIECE — no discrete hub diameter measurable (earlier 0.8500" was an approx across the central boss, treat EST.). PENDING: confirm dim mapping (which length is OAL vs to-impeller; what 0.8500" is); ring OD vs ring ID. Basket attachment MECHANISM (confirmed): basket pushes onto the spindle and is secured against a flat retention spring (SPN-006) held by a brass screw (SPN-007) at the impeller hub; 3 ring pins assist location. Photo evidence: photos/gasket/

The impeller/fan vanes are INTEGRAL to the one-piece aluminum spindle (SPN-002), confirmed from photos — NOT a separate bracket. Retained as a named feature of SPN-002 (earlier 'top impeller bracket' guess superseded). CONFIRM whether any separate bracket also exists

NOT a separate coupling part: the armature lower journal (SHF-003) slides into the SPN-002 bore and is held by the set screw (SPN-005). Retained as the named joint. CONFIRM no separate fanwheel/fork exists

NEW PART. Set screw that locks the armature lower journal (SHF-003) inside the basket drive spindle (SPN-002) bore. FULLY SPECIFIED: thread 1/4-20 (CONFIRMED, RH); length 0.185" (CONFIRMED); slotted drive (CONFIRMED)

NEW PART (confirmed by user). A THREE-PRONG (3-leg) STEEL spring at the spindle (SPN-002) impeller hub; it COMPRESSES as the basket is seated, holding the basket on (the basket pushes on and secures against it). Held to the hub by the brass retaining screw (SPN-007). MEASURED 2026-06-15 (per leg): height 0.24" (CONFIRMED); length 0.95" (CONFIRMED); thickness 0.0265" (CONFIRMED); overall/free spread 1.91" (CONFIRMED, tip-to-tip); 3 legs confirmed. PENDING: how it indexes to the hub

NEW PART. Brass round/dome-head screw that fastens the basket retention spring (SPN-006) to the center of the spindle (SPN-002) impeller hub. MEASURED 2026-06-15: thread #6-32 (CONFIRMED — corrected from #6-24); length 0.465" (CONFIRMED); head dia 0.265" (CONFIRMED); brass dome head, slotted. FULLY SPECIFIED

column3: Deck Plate / Platform Plate / Gasket Mount Disk
column4: FLAT thin metal disk (per user: 'the platform'). The tapered rubber gasket (PLT-002) mounts onto it. Center hole (shaft pass-through) + 6 peripheral holes. ONE OF ONLY TWO PARTS in this group (metal disk + rubber gasket). MEASURED 2026-06-15 (Mitutoyo): OD 3.0085" (CONFIRMED); thickness 0.0550" (CONFIRMED — thin sheet). ASSEMBLY (confirmed from photos): the platform disk + tapered gasket (PLT-002) stack onto the LOWER HOUSING (LH-001) and are clamped by the two long screws/studs ('metal tubes') passing through the stack — believed to be the FLG-002 housing bolts (CONFIRM vs separate standoff tubes). Center bore shows a metal collar/bushing (confirm if separate part). MEASURED 2026-06-15: center-hole ID 0.370" (CONFIRMED); 6 peripheral holes ID 0.310" (CONFIRMED) on a 2.300" bolt circle (CONFIRMED — matches FLG-002/housing circle); 6 outer holes have raised INTEGRAL drawn eyelets/collars. HOLE ROLES (CONFIRMED): of the 6, **2 take the FLG-002 tie-bolts** (clamp the deck to the housing) and **4 take rivets (PLT-005)** that permanently mount the gasket (PLT-002) to the disk. Center hole is INTEGRAL in the plate (no separate bushing). PLT-001 + PLT-002 co-drilled on the 2.300" circle. Photo evidence: photos/gasket/

VOID. There are ONLY TWO platform-group parts: the metal disk (PLT-001) and the rubber gasket (PLT-002). The 'thick cast ring' measured here was the tapered RUBBER GASKET — folded into PLT-002. ID retained for traceability, not reused

column3: Jar Seal / Platform Gasket / Splash Seal
column4: Molded rubber gasket, TAPERED to wedge into the glass jar mouth and seal around the spinning basket so cleaning solution doesn't splash out; mounts onto the flat metal platform disk (PLT-001). The substantial tapered body (first mis-seen as a 'cast ring') IS this rubber gasket. Has a matching 6-hole pattern (some counterbored) aligning with PLT-001 on the 2.300" bolt circle; the FLG-002 bolts pass through both (user-confirmed via annotated photo). Clearly much thicker than the PLT-001 metal disk. CONFIRMED = the molded seal reconditioned in restoration log R-1 (U.S. PATENT 1872812). TAPER (CONFIRMED): wide 3.5015" face seats on the disk side, tapering down to the narrow 3.2015" end which inserts into the glass jar. Riveted to PLT-001 by 4 rivets (PLT-005). MEASURED 2026-06-15: wide OD 3.5015" (CONFIRMED); second dia 3.2015" (CONFIRMED — step along taper); center bore 1.5505" (CONFIRMED — shaft/basket pass-through); overall height 0.8082" (CONFIRMED); wall/section readings 0.3510", 0.1590", 0.3095" (CONFIRMED); hole ID 0.310" (CONFIRMED — matches PLT-001 holes; FLG-002 through both); seat/flange thickness 0.1805" (CONFIRMED — at the flat face mating the disk). PENDING: characterize taper (which dia is top vs bottom); confirm gasket identity. Photo evidence: photos/gasket/

column3: Spacer Tube / Standoff Sleeve / Metal Tube
column4: NEW PART (confirmed by user). Two hollow metal tubes in the platform mounting stack; the FLG-002 housing bolts pass THROUGH these tubes. Set the standoff/spacing between the platform deck (PLT-001) + gasket (PLT-002) and the lower housing (LH-001). Qty 2. MEASURED 2026-06-15 (Mitutoyo): length 0.6990" (CONFIRMED); OD 0.3765" (CONFIRMED); bore ID 0.2020" (CONFIRMED — clears FLG-002 thread ~0.189"); wall ~0.0873" (SYN — matches the 0.0860" reading). One end is EXTERNALLY TAPERED — the OD necks in toward the tip (a slight domed/beveled nose); earlier ~0.2330-0.2365" tip readings were taken on this tapered nose, NOT the 0.3765" main OD or 0.2020" bore. The TAPERED END FACES THE HOUSING (LH-001) on install (CONFIRMED by photo 2026-06-20). Main OD 0.3765" + 0.2020" through-bore unchanged. Photo evidence: photos/gasket/

Fastens the tapered gasket (PLT-002) to the platform disk (PLT-001) through 4 of the 6 holes on the 2.300" bolt circle (the other 2 holes take the FLG-002 bolts), under the original washers (PLT-006). Qty 4. ORIGINAL CONFIG: 4 permanent rivets (dims unrecoverable — drilled out). RESTORATION CONFIG (2026-06-16): rivets drilled out to service the gasket; replaced per hole with a STAINLESS M4-0.7 x 10 mm FLAT-HEAD PHILLIPS screw + STAINLESS M4-0.7 hex nut, REUSING the original washers (PLT-006). Flat (countersunk) head gives the flush finish. Mirrors the main-gasket screw-and-nut upgrade philosophy.

ORIGINAL PART. Flat washer under each gasket deck fastener (PLT-005) where it clamps the gasket (PLT-002) to the disk (PLT-001). OD 0.4385" (CONFIRMED); thickness 0.0415" (CONFIRMED); ID 0.1570" (CONFIRMED; two readings 0.155-0.157"). Qty 4. Retained/reused in the restoration. FIT: 0.157" ~= M4 nominal (0.1575"/4mm) — the M4 restoration screw clears cleanly. FULLY SPEC'D.
Rollup: the complete watch-parts cleaning basket as mounted; hangs below the platform disk (PLT-001). PROVISIONAL pending part breakdown

Cylindrical fine stainless-steel mesh basket; holds watch parts in the cleaning/rinse fluid. Top has a metal collar/rim with 3 BAYONET LUGS (J-slots) that engage the 3 ring pins on the spindle (SPN-002) and lock against the retention spring (SPN-006). Fitted with a flip lid/cover (BSK-003). MEASURED 2026-06-15: OD 2.8025" (CONFIRMED, outer mesh); overall height 2.25" (CONFIRMED — base to top of J bracket/bayonet lug). NOMINAL/STANDARD basket dia for this system = 2 3/4" (2.750") per external data — our measured OD ~matches; LATER models (Mark 2+) used 2 1/4" (2.250") baskets (model-differentiation note for the manual). mesh 24 (CONFIRMED — 24 openings/in); wire dia 0.0240" (CONFIRMED); opening ~0.0177" (SYN). Bayonet slot (CONFIRMED): width 0.1855" (clears the 0.125" SPN-002 pin), axial entry 0.420", hook run 0.2700". PENDING: collar dims (minor). Photo evidence: photos/basket/ (+ this session)
